sub: The Doctor answers farmers' questions in the app. Here you check its answers, keep a bank of answers written by people, and see where many farmers ask about the same problem.
correction_hint: Write what the Doctor should have said. Good corrections can go into the answer bank.
rate_note: Ratings show which problems the Doctor answers badly, so the answer bank can fix them first.
bank_note: The answer bank holds answers written and checked by people. When a farmer asks about one of these problems, the Doctor must use the approved answer instead of writing its own. Answers that are not approved are not used.
bank_need: Write the question and the answer in Kurdish or English.
map_note: Early warning: when many farmers in one district ask about the same problem in a short time, it can be the start of a pest or disease. Send an officer to look, or send an alert.
rules_note: These rules are fixed on the server. They cannot be switched off from this site, so no admin can make the Doctor unsafe by mistake.
rule_doses_why: The Doctor never says how many litres, kilograms or millilitres of a pesticide or fertilizer to use.
rule_brands_why: It names the problem, not what to buy.
rule_numbers_why: Every number it gives comes from the satellite, weather, dam or market data, never invented.
rule_unsure: Says when it is not sure
rule_unsure_why: When it cannot tell, it answers unsure and the question goes to an officer.
rule_privacy_why: It never shows one farmer's name, phone or field to another farmer.
